data.title: 伽玛 · 黄昏会长办公室的签批
data.description: 四越商会总部的会长办公室里，伽玛身着靛蓝晚礼服坐在堆满账本与契约的高背椅前。夕阳透过落地窗洒在她的长发上，她提笔签下新一季的扩张计划，唇角带着运筹帷幄的微笑。
data.location: president office of a grand trading company with tall windows, stacks of ledgers and contracts on a mahogany desk
data.action: sitting at the desk signing a document, quill in hand, confident smile, long indigo hair over one shoulder
data.lighting: 落地窗透入的黄昏金光与桌面烛台的暖光
data.mood: composed business elegance, quiet ambition, golden hour glow
data.promptProse: In the president's office at dusk, Gamma in an indigo gown signs the season's expansion plan, ledgers stacked neatly beside her.
data.animaCaption: Golden dusk light falls across the ledgers as Gamma signs, every number already calculated in her head.
